summary: Data analyst with a Master's degree in Data Science and hands-on experience in Python, SQL and dashboarding. Keen to turn messy data into clear decisions.

skills.label: Tools & Technologies
skills.items: Tableau, Excel, Power BI, scikit-learn, Pandas, Flask

skills.label: Cloud
skills.items: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform

bullets: Built a **Tableau** dashboard tracking weekly sales that three teams used in their Monday meetings.
Cleaned and joined 50,000+ customer records with Python and SQL, cutting report preparation time.
Wrote SQL queries to support A/B test analysis for the marketing team.
Presented findings to non-technical stakeholders in weekly reviews.
Documented data definitions for the analytics team wiki.
Analysed survey data from 1,200 respondents using R and presented results in a short report.
Created visualisations of survey results for a conference poster.
Cleaned inconsistent survey responses and documented every change.
Coordinated with two supervisors to schedule interviews.
Trained a random forest classifier in scikit-learn to flag customers likely to churn.
Deployed a small Flask service that returned churn scores to the support team.
Compared three models and reported precision and recall to the team.
Wrote unit tests for the feature engineering code.
Resolved customer queries by phone and email with a strong satisfaction record.
Trained four new colleagues on the ticketing system.
Reported recurring issues to the product team each month.
Handled cash and card payments accurately in a busy store.
Guided prospective students around campus during open days.
Answered questions about courses and student life.
Wrote short blog posts about student life.

projects.name: Customer Churn Predictor
bullets: Built an end-to-end churn model with feature engineering and cross-validation.
Served predictions through a Flask API with simple input validation.
Tracked experiments in a spreadsheet and compared model variants.
Wrote a README explaining how to reproduce results.

projects.name: Sales Dashboard
bullets: Designed an interactive dashboard of regional sales with drill-down filters.
Wrote SQL views to feed the dashboard from a PostgreSQL database.
Added tooltips and colour choices that work for colour-blind users.

projects.name: Campus Bike Share Map
bullets: Built a small web map showing bike stations and availability.
Added a search box to find the nearest free bike.
Hosted the site for free on GitHub Pages.
